use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Numerics.BitOperations

use Armies = (black: ulong, white: ulong)

attack_masks(n: int) -> ulong[] is
    let masks = LIST[ulong]()

    for cell in 0..n * n do
        let row = cell / n
        let column = cell % n
        let mask mut = 0ul

        for other in 0..n * n do
            let r = other / n
            let c = other % n

            if r == row \/ c == column \/
                    r - c == row - column \/ r + c == row + column then
                mask = mask | (1ul << other)
            fi
        od

        masks.add(mask)
    od

    return masks |> collect_array()
si

search(
    attacks: ulong[], left: int, next_black: int, next_white: int,
    black: ulong, white: ulong, black_reach: ulong, white_reach: ulong
) -> Armies? is
    if left == 0 then
        return (black = black, white = white)
    fi

    let taken = black | white
    let everything = (1ul << attacks.count - 1) * 2ul - 1ul
    let for_black =
        everything & \((1ul << next_black) - 1ul) & \(taken | white_reach)
    let for_white =
        everything & \((1ul << next_white) - 1ul) & \(taken | black_reach)

    if BitOperations.pop_count(for_black) < left \/
            BitOperations.pop_count(for_white) < left then
        return null
    fi

    for b in next_black..attacks.count do
        let bit = 1ul << b

        if (taken | white_reach) & bit == 0ul then
            let reach = black_reach | attacks[b]

            for w in next_white..attacks.count do
                let other = 1ul << w

                if (taken | bit | reach) & other == 0ul then
                    let found = search(
                        attacks, left - 1, b + 1, w + 1,
                        black | bit, white | other,
                        reach, white_reach | attacks[w])

                    if found? then
                        return found
                    fi
                fi
            od
        fi
    od

    return null
si

solve(m: int, n: int) -> Armies? =>
    search(attack_masks(n), m, 0, 0, 0ul, 0ul, 0ul, 0ul)

show(armies: Armies, n: int) is
    for row in 0..n do
        let squares = (0..n) |> map(column =>
            let bit = 1ul << row * n + column in
            if armies.black & bit != 0ul then "B"
            elif armies.white & bit != 0ul then "W"
            elif (row + column) % 2 == 0 then "."
            else ":"
            fi)

        write_line("    {squares |> join(" ")}")
    od
si

draw(armies: Armies, n: int, file: string) is
    let square = 44
    let image = IMAGE(n * square, n * square)

    image.view(0.0D, cast double(n), cast double(n), 0.0D)

    for row in 0..n do
        for column in 0..n do
            let x = cast double(column)
            let y = cast double(row)
            let bit = 1ul << row * n + column

            if (row + column) % 2 == 0 then
                image.colour(238ub, 216ub, 181ub)
            else
                image.colour(181ub, 136ub, 99ub)
            fi

            image.fill_rectangle(x, y, x + 1.0D, y + 1.0D)

            if armies.black & bit != 0ul then
                image.colour(25ub, 25ub, 25ub)
                image.disc(x + 0.5D, y + 0.5D, 0.32D)
            elif armies.white & bit != 0ul then
                image.colour(25ub, 25ub, 25ub)
                image.disc(x + 0.5D, y + 0.5D, 0.33D)
                image.colour(250ub, 250ub, 250ub)
                image.disc(x + 0.5D, y + 0.5D, 0.29D)
            fi
        od
    od

    image.write(file)
    image.show(file)
si

for (m, n) in [(4, 5), (9, 8), (10, 8)] do
    if let armies = solve(m, n) then
        write_line("{m} black and {m} white queens on a {n} by {n} board:")
        show(armies, n)
        draw(armies, n, "queens-{m}-{n}.png")
    else
        write_line("{m} of each colour cannot share a {n} by {n} board")
    fi

    write_line()
od
